snippet.title: CyberCar — Free Neon Arcade Browser Game | Official Gameplay
snippet.description:
CyberCar is a free arcade survival game you can play right now in your browser. Orbit the arena, dodge waves of enemies, collect 14 unique power-ups, battle named bosses, and fight for the top spot on the global leaderboard.

▶️  Play free now: https://cybercar.com

No download. No signup. No ads. Just pure arcade action.

FEATURES:
🕹️  One-touch controls — tap or press Space to reverse
💥 14 power-ups — lasers, fireballs, cannons, shields, Pac-Man-style ingestion
👾 11 unlockable themes — each with unique enemies, bosses, vehicles & music
🏆 Global top 100 leaderboard with classic 3-letter initials
🛒 Cosmetic shop — themes, car colors, trails, effects (all earned, no real money)
🔥 Daily login streaks & coin rewards
📱 Works on desktop and mobile

LINKS:
🌐 Website: https://cybercar.com
📖 Wiki: https://cybercar.fandom.com/wiki/CyberCar_Wiki
🎮 itch.io: https://philooo2.itch.io/cybercar
👾 Newgrounds: https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/963329
